description: Create an issue (task) in a project. Description supports Markdown.

assignee.description: a member name (see list_members) or "me"; any other text is kept as a free-text assignee

client.description: client name or id; when omitted the issue belongs to its project's client

created_by.description: who is creating it, e.g. the session/agent name

fields.description: custom fields of the project (see list_fields): { "Field name": value }: text, a number, "YYYY-MM-DD", one option, a list of options, a https:// link, a member name, true/false, payments = a list [{amount, currency? (when it is not the currency of the field; converted at the rate of its date), date?, paid (true = received, false = expected), note?}] (always send the whole list)

labels.description: the whole list of labels, e.g. ["bug", "mobile"]; replaces the current ones

priority.description: urgent, high, medium, low or none

status.description: one of the 6 kinds backlog, todo, in_progress, in_review, done, canceled, or the NAME of one of the project's own statuses (get_project -> statuses); a kind picks the first own status of that kind

title.description: short title, e.g. "Fix the checkout button on mobile"

name: create_issue
